propositions: Plan review dominates LLM spend with high re-run rates, driving an evidence-backed program to cut token usage without weakening gate outcomes.
Pass-1 usage instrumentation adds input/output/cache token accounting to sidecar coverage metrics before dependent cache optimizations land.
Pre-LLM short-circuits and DET pre-gates reduce calls for zero-finding and deterministic-floor criteria.
Blocking criteria (T3, T10, T5c HIGH, G7 contradicts_reality) are enabled with operator-approved thresholds while all previously blocking criteria remain blocking.
criteria_routing.json changes are serialized to avoid textual conflicts, and pass1.py/passes.py cache changes are chained by file overlap.
A discovered regression on container output-token scaling was filed as follow-up bug 30a2.
